model.name: CNN-LSTM
model.full_name: Convolutional Neural Network - Long Short-Term Memory
model.purpose: Classifies monitored water-quality data as Safe or Unsafe.

CNN.role: Extracts important local features and patterns from water-quality input sequences.

LSTM.role: Learns temporal patterns and relationships between observations over time.

output.description: The model predicts the water-quality class based on the monitored sensor parameters.

agent_usage.purpose: The Agentic AI uses the CNN-LSTM prediction as one of the inputs for reasoning and decision-making.
agent_usage.role_of_agent: Reasoning, interpretation, decision-making, recommendation, and user interaction

important_rules: The Agent should not replace the CNN-LSTM prediction.
The Agent should use the model prediction together with sensor values and knowledge-base rules.
The system should not claim complete drinking-water safety based only on the four monitored parameters.
Model predictions should be presented as predictions of the trained system.
